correctness.rationale: Edge increments x_i=u_{i+1}-u_i are zero-sum and satisfy dot x_i=Phi(x_{i-1})+Phi(x_{i+1})-2Phi(x_i). The monotonicity of the sign and Phi gives contraction for uniform weights. For n>=6 disjoint sparse dipoles at j and j+3 impose d_j+d_{j+3}<=0 for d_j=w_{j-1}+w_{j+1}-2w_j, whose cyclic sum forces paired equality; perturbing the dipole with epsilon, q=p-1>1, yields a positive first-order term if any d_j≠0, hence each d_j=0 and all weights equal. For n<=5, strict negativity of uniform gradient TV on nonzero zero-sum gradients follows graph diameter<=2 and gives openness by compactness. Independent exact sign-chamber rational calculation found maximum -1/4 for p=3 weighted C5, zero for p=2 alternating C6, +1/2 for p=3 alternating C6. The claim does not cover 1<p<2 or arbitrary conductances.
